title: Cost Narrative Workbench — per-message cost explorer & pricing pattern composer
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and prototype a 'Cost Narrative Workbench' for Redwood Console: a focused UI that lets engineers and product owners explore per-message (token-level) cost traces, build pricing scenarios, and export role-aware reports. The workbench bundles three coordinated panes: a timeline of consumption events (message-level), an attribution ribbon that links messages to routes/models/rollouts, and a pricing-slate composer for simulating price tiers and generating export artifacts. Key goals: make attribution auditable, surface common pricing anti-patterns, enable quick CSV/JSON exports scoped to teams or promos, and provide guardrails for canary/beta rollouts tied to cost thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype shows three synchronized panes: timeline (message unit rows), attribution ribbon (route->model->customer mapping), and pricing-slate composer
Users can filter timeline by date, model, route, customer, and tag; filtered view updates attribution ribbon and export preview
Export feature supports role-aware CSV and compact JSON bundle that includes per-message token counts, model variant, quantization profile, and applied pricing snapshot
Pricing-slate composer lets user define up to 3 tiers, associate a tier with a route or customer group, and preview per-message and aggregate cost impact
UI surface includes inline explainers for 'prefix cache saved tokens' and 'continuous batching adjustment' and links to docs
Prototype validated in a 60-minute design review with PM and two eng reviewers; feedback captured and actionable items added
Accessibility: all interactive controls keyboard reachable and labeled; color contrast meets AA for charts
Performance: timeline rendering mock handles 2k messages in client prototype without jank
comments: 2026-02-28 Ava Chen: Kickoff - aligned on scope with PM, outlined three-pane concept. Decided to prioritize per-message export and pricing simulation over advanced anomaly detection for this cycle.
2026-03-03 Diego Morales: Early wireframes iterated; added 'quantization filter' and compact export bundle format. Requested eng input on data availability for per-message traces.
2026-03-05 Priya Kapoor (PM): Confirmed customer use-cases: chargeback CSV for finance, canary cost guardrail for platform team. Suggested adding role-aware columns to exports.

2026-03-08 Eng review (Liam O'Rourke): Feasibility notes - per-message traces available via telemetry API but will require server-side paging. Suggested lazy-loading timeline and sampling for large ranges.

2026-03-10 Design review: Presented prototype to PM and two backend engineers. Agreed to implement timeline virtualization, add a 'scenario diff' view for pricing-slate comparisons, and include a small audit trail for exported snapshots.
2026-03-12 Diego Morales: Updated prototype with improved CSV column ordering and added keyboard shortcuts doc. Raised follow-up: validation rules for pricing tiers (min/max per-token values).
notes: Differentiators: the workbench focuses on narrative flow (trace -> attribute -> price) rather than raw charts. Exports are designed to be audit-ready for finance and compliance. This is intended as a developer-first feature: dense data, keyboard power tools, and links to infra traces for debugging.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Large export bundles may expose sensitive PII if customer messages are included - Mitigation: default export scrubs message content, include only derived metadata and token counts
Risk: Per-message traces expensive to query - Mitigation: require retention window and sampling options; educate users in UI with cost estimate before export
Risk: Pricing-slate complexity confuses non-technical users - Mitigation: provide 'presets' for common patterns and inline examples
